decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would maintain the safety of other road and footway users and would not harm the appearance of the house, the surrounding area and neighbouring properties.  The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1  (New Development), T.4.4  (Road Safety) and T.5.3  (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP (2003), and Section 11 (Roads, Footpaths, Parking and Servicing) of the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The width of the crossover shall be 2.4 metres.
Condition : 6 - The existing front boundary treatment shall be reinstated except at the point of access to path and hardstanding.
description: Formation of a vehicle access to front of house.
